title: HTTP/3 datagrams dissection
description:
Implemented HTTP/3 datagrams dissection according to RFC 9297.

1. Added new dissector table "quic.proto.datagram" for datagram QUIC dissectors. HTTP3 is the only current user but other protocols may start using QUIC datagrams in the future
2. Added datagram dissector in HTTP/3 code

At the moment value of HTTP/3 datagram dissection is very limited (just a single Quarter-stream varint), but this is a necessary building block to add dissection for CONNECT-IP (RFC 9484) and other protocols that use HTTP/3 datagrams.
